'''September 2000 Las Vegas tournament (30 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, NV on 30 September 2000. [[Kris Lavigne]] won it. It is known from Kris Lavigne's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1281">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-las-vegas-nv-9-30d1281/ las-vegas-nv-9-30], DeckTech (Kris "VegasPimp" Lavigne, 30 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-30-las-vegas-nv-9-30d1281/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kris Lavigne]]
